DREAD.JACKAL.description: At the start of combat, all enemies gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Electrified[/gold].
DREAD.LECH_KRIL.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Heat[/gold].
DREAD.LEPHANTIS.description: At the end of every [blue]3[/blue] turns, all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold].
DREAD.PHORID.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
DREAD.RAPTOR.description: All enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Soar[/gold] at the start of [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, and every turn after that.
DREAD.VAY_HEK.description: At the start of turn [blue]2[/blue], lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold].
